currentParagraphText: “I understand,” the Sword Saint nodded. He didn’t take the warning lightly either. He wasn’t Jake, who seemingly had a total immunity to presences. As a Transcendent, he had higher presence resistance than others, but Miyamoto still wasn’t sure how strong his resistance was at this point. He hoped that his status as a Transcendent and the passive improvements from being around Jake would be enough to not lose all dignity in front of the god.
